checks.name: shipped default: analytics is OFF — no request, no storage, calculators unchanged
page views: a live re-render on every keystroke is NOT a new page view; navigation is
calculator: start on first input (once), complete 2 s after the last input with a valid result (once); no input values sent
calculator: abandonment = started, then left before a completion (no calc_complete; page_leave sent)
engagement: active time is counted; time after 30 s without activity is not
search: result count after 1.5 s idle, click rank on choosing a result; the search text is never sent
Premium funnel: gate view on a Premium calculator, offer view + sign-in request on Profile, checkout return once
privacy: every payload has only envelope fields; page keys never carry a URL, query or email; GPC => session-only visitor id
ingestion down: calculators keep working, no page error, queue stays capped at 50, sending backs off
completion classifier: empty, placeholder, NaN/Infinity, errors and text are not results; numbers in real formats are
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): default result on screen, nobody types: no start, no completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): scripted fill (untrusted input event): ignored
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): valid integer result after typing: one completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): decimal result: completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): several result fields (one "—", one formatted with units): completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): NaN result: no completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): error message: no completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): non-numeric text result: no completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): input that does not re-render the calculator (old default result still showing): no completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): result appears 1 s after the input: completion
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): result appears 3 s after the input: completion once it appears
completion (synthetic calculator, real typing): valid, then invalidated by more input within 2 s: no completion; later valid: exactly one
completion on real calculators, two per LAB (gasoline, diesel, EV, towing, universal): exactly one each, nothing before typing
real calculator, unparseable input ("abc") showing "—": no completion
catalogue sweep: result-area verdict for every free calculator after an input (exceptions listed in evidence)
performance: typing into a calculator with analytics ON vs OFF (same machine, alternating runs)
